This appendix is the sanctioned bridge between the book's mechanism-first
language and the names used in papers, libraries, and search queries. A name
identifies a family; it does not remove the need to state axes, precision,
state, or assumptions.

::: {.table-responsive}

| Primitive in this book | Standard name or aliases | Notation and diagnostic contract | Unit |
|:--------------------------|:-----------------------|:---------------------------------|:---------|
| Coordinate-wise or token-wise normalization | LayerNorm; RMSNorm | Axes; centering; scale; $\varepsilon$ placement | C15 |
| Batch-and-spatial coordinate normalization | BatchNorm | Running and batch statistics are distinct estimators | C15 |
| Variance-preserving initialization | Xavier/Glorot; He/Kaiming | Variance convention; nonlinearity assumptions | C14 |
| Diagonal moment preconditioning | Adam; AdamW | Moments; bias correction; decay; $\varepsilon$ placement | C13/C17 |
| Similarity-weighted aggregation | attention; self-attention | Scale; normalized axis; mask; materialization | Synthesis |
| IO-aware exact all-pairs aggregation | FlashAttention | Exact map; finite-precision order | Synthesis |
| Matrix-aware or orthogonalized update | Muon; Shampoo; SOAP | Routing; iteration count; scale; state | C17 |
| Quantized random projection or update sketch | QJL; TurboQuant | Quantizer; estimator; sketch size; hardware endpoint | C17 |

:::

The unit column records where the full entry is scheduled, not where the
literature name is owned. Each completed row will gain a stable chapter anchor,
sibling pointer when applicable, primary citation, and tested aliases.
